Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Blood Weakens
Type: Event
Gehenna. Do not replace until a vampire commits diablerie.
Cards that require any Disciplines to play are not replaced until the
end of the current action or until any Methuselah's hand is empty
(whichever comes first). Any vampire who commits diablerie is immune
to this effect until the next Gehenna card is played.

Rewind Time
Type: Reaction
Requires: Temporis/Presence
Cost: 2 blood
[TEM] Burn a non-out-of-turn master card as it is played during any
other Methuselah's master phase (usable by a ready, untapped vampire
even though there is no action). That master card has no effect. No
cost is paid. The Methuselah who played that card gains another master
phase action.

So, there's no "current action" occuring when you play Rewind Time. Do
you simply never replace it?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
